asA: the operator as product owner of rcf-lite
iWant: to be asked the profile questions once, in plain words, and have my answers recorded
soThat: D1 passes on my answers, not on a guess
title: The operator answers the two product-owner profile questions that D1 asks

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given this repository at this slice's reviewed head or any later head, when node bin/rcf.js define readiness --level intent --check brief runs, then it exits 0, brief:profile reads 2/2, and the recorded answers for profile:surface and profile:register are the operator's, recorded by the test-author with the ruling's source named.

[failure] Given a scratch copy of this slice's reviewed head or any later head with the profile answers removed, node bin/rcf.js define readiness --level intent --check brief exits 4 naming profile:surface and profile:register as the product owner's questions.

[must-not] No hand other than the operator decides the profile answers: the DEFINE round that records them quotes the operator's answer and its date, and no record in this repository answers profile:surface or profile:register without that source.
